validation.semantics: Read all 20 values against the English source, the context sidecar and the render sites in team-bridge-emoji-picker.tsx (search as aria-label and placeholder; categories/all/category0-8 as aria-label and title; frequent as heading and row aria-label; tone/toneDefault as select aria-label and first option; noResults as visible empty text; choose as grid aria-label) and team-bridge-reactions.tsx (add as icon-button aria-label; failed in role=alert). reactions.empty appears only in keys.gen.ts and is not rendered; it is byte-identical to noResults. Register: آپ-form respectful imperatives (شامل کریں، تلاش کریں، منتخب کریں، دوبارہ کوشش کریں), no تم/تو, no '!', no padding honorifics. The phrasing matches locale precedent: 'فائلیں تلاش کریں' (search), 'کوئی ایجنٹ نہیں ملا' / 'کوئی اثاثہ نہیں ملا' (No … found), 'اثاثہ محفوظ نہیں ہو سکا۔' and 34 x 'دوبارہ کوشش کریں' (failed), 'ڈیفالٹ' (Default), 'زمرے' (categories). Gender agreement checked: ردعمل (masc.) takes ہو سکا, and ایموجی takes masculine ملا in both empty and noResults. toneDefault 'ڈیفالٹ رنگت' leaves out 'skin', which the adjacent 'جلد کی رنگت' select label supplies; it is accurate and suits the narrow option. The group names were compared with the CLDR 46 ur characterLabels (cldr-misc-full@46.0.0 via jsDelivr). travel_places 'سفر اور مقامات', flags 'پرچم' and symbols 'علامات' match exactly. activities 'سرگرمیاں' is the plural of CLDR 'سرگرمی' and matches the English plural. objects 'اشیاء' is native Urdu where CLDR uses the transliterated 'آبجیکٹس'; animals 'جانور اور فطرت' and food 'کھانا اور مشروبات' are everyday-register variants of CLDR 'حیوانات و فطرت' and 'غذا اور مشروب'; smileys 'اسمائلیز' is a common spelling variant of CLDR 'اسمالیز'. All are acceptable under the style guide's everyday educated register, so none is a finding.
